description: LedgerStore WAL records which are damage, each named by the first rule it breaks in check order (ledgerstore.md §7.3): a record shorter than its key, a slot record with an empty value, or a slot record of a handle at or above the catalog's next handle, is damage which preserved the page CRC; a store record which breaks a rule of its format is a damaged create, drop, or seal, and a case breaking two adjacent store-record rules pins their order.

cases.name: A record of 7 bytes, shorter than its key.
Handle 5 when the catalog's next handle is 5.
An empty value at handle 1, slot 7: a slot record holds DATA.
A store record of kind 4.
A create whose body is 17 bytes.
A create with an empty body.
A drop whose body is 12 bytes.
A drop with an empty body.
A seal whose body is 8 bytes.
A seal with an empty body.
A create of ledger 0.
A drop of ledger 0.
A seal of ledger 0.
A create taking the store handle, 2^24 - 1.
A seal of the store handle, 2^24 - 1.
A create of window 0.
A create of window 2^31, above 2^31 - 1.
A store record of kind 4 with an empty body, a length no kind takes: named by store-kind-unknown, which precedes the body-length rules.
A create whose body is 17 bytes, of ledger 0: named by create-body-length, which precedes zero-ledger.
A drop whose body is 12 bytes, of ledger 0: named by drop-body-length, which precedes zero-ledger.
A seal whose body is 8 bytes, of ledger 0: named by seal-body-length, which precedes zero-ledger.
A create of ledger 0 taking the store handle, 2^24 - 1: named by zero-ledger, which precedes handle-out-of-range.
A seal of ledger 0 and the store handle, 2^24 - 1: named by zero-ledger, which precedes handle-out-of-range.
A create taking the store handle, 2^24 - 1, with window 0: named by handle-out-of-range, which precedes window-out-of-range.
A create whose first pair has window 0 and whose second has ledger 0: named by the first pair's window-out-of-range, which precedes the second pair's zero-ledger.
